name: legal-clinic
description: Client intake, legal memos, deadline tracking, and student task routing for law school clinics and legal aid organizations.
author: Anthropic

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Initial practice profile setup — learns your clinic's practice areas, jurisdiction, supervising attorneys, and student team in 10-15 minutes

skills.name: client-intake
skills.description: Structure a new client matter — capture presenting facts, identify applicable legal theories, and flag conflicts

skills.name: memo
skills.description: Draft a structured legal memorandum (Question Presented, Short Answer, Facts, Analysis, Conclusion) on a specified legal question

skills.name: deadlines
skills.description: Track filing deadlines, statutes of limitations, and court date calendars across active clinic matters

skills.name: student-ramp
skills.description: Onboard a new student clinician — brief the practice area, explain the matter queue, and assign initial research tasks
